headline: Elvis and Eminem rights holders sue AI music generator Suno
summary: Rights holders for Elvis Presley and Eminem have filed new lawsuits against AI music generator Suno, the latest in a series of suits against the company. The suits claim Suno illegally generates music and lyrics mimicking the artists, with the Presley suit's lawyers alleging a violation of Tennessee law.
